description: See a video, an image or a folder of frames. Returns one contact sheet (evenly spaced frames, each labelled with its timestamp) and facts: duration, size, fps, loudness in LUFS, silent stretches, black stretches, missing frames. Use it before editing footage and after every render to check your own work. Pass `at` for one full-size frame, or `start`/`end` to look closer at a stretch.

at.description: Return one full frame at this second.

path.description: Video file, image file, or folder of numbered frames.

name: look
title: Look at a video
